explanation: LR decision = sigmoid(intercept + sum(coef_j * (x_j - median_j)/scale_j)). For 74/M/10/23/1, the large negative mmse coefficient (-4.89 on standardized MMSE) dominates: mmse=23 is far below the imputed median (~28-29) after standardization, producing a large positive logit contribution; education 10 and ses 1 also carry negative coefficients (lower education/SES -> higher screening odds); male (sex=1) has a positive coefficient. The result is a logit far above 0, hence sigmoid -> ~0.99998.
